name: Director Morag Strachan

intro.text: Stand back from the gunwale. The Wardstone's in the water and the sonar says something very big is listening.
If you win, I lose my bonus. If I win, I lose my bonus anyway. Lord Vane's like that. Let's go.

win: Fine. Fine. I'll take the boat back. Slowly. Something's following it.
after: Tell Garside the Enclosure's pulling out of Scotland. We were never wanted here anyway.
